name: learning-loop
description: Self-improving learning loop across coding-agent sessions: retrieval, capture, consolidation, and cross-project transfer

interface.shortDescription: Second brain for coding agents: retrieval, capture, consolidation
interface.longDescription: Retrieves what you already know at session start, captures insights as atomic notes during work, and consolidates them between sessions. Backed by an Obsidian vault, a hybrid-search Rust binary, and per-note provenance.
